what_moved_to_the_host: Which entities stand in each sector and in what order a scan visits them (membership and insertion history): the host holds it (eech-world/src/roster.rs SectorRoster, served by model_host.rs entity_scan_answer/roster_event). A key is issued per insertion and never reused; a relink is a removal plus a new insertion with a new sequence number (tail-first = oldest first).

The sector of an entity is decided by the host: a hosted mobile from its own ONE canonical Movers record (the stated position is only compared; mismatch is a named [roster.pose] refusal), every other entity from the position the campaign states at the insertion (only the sector and sequence are kept, no coordinate, no second pose).

The scan entry is served by the host key: FIRST (oldest of the named sector), NEXT (the entry after the one the campaign is standing at, named in the identity place). The real Core sector list is only the conformance mirror: entity_scan.roster_mirror (disagreement), entity_scan.roster_key (key names no entity), entity_scan.key (malformed key / key on a state that serves none), [roster.key] (ended/unknown/misplaced), [roster.missing] (no roster); never an end, a miss or a fallback.

The campaign reports every sector-list write through the existing funnel (en_list.c insert/delete hooks), heap release (set_free_entity) and boot (campaign_place_reset). Transport: the existing ENTITY_SCAN question (phases 4 INSERT, 5 REMOVE, 6 RESET; identity place carries a hosted mobile identity or the key; the reply name carries the key); engine/dc/sys layers carry identity and key.
